name: Sri Mayura Golden Temple
description: Sri Mayura Golden Temple, located in Monaragala, is a Kovil dedicated to Lord Murugan, revered as the protector deity. Its historical and spiritual significance make it a must-visit for those interested in Hindu worship and Sri Lankan culture.

historical_significance: Rajasinha I, also known as Rajasinghe I, ascended to the throne of Sitawaka in 1578 after his father Mayadunne's death.
